result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear visual defect: the hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, showing a gray broken-image placeholder. A few smaller edge-truncation issues are also visible.

issues.description: The restaurant image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, displaying a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of the actual photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source URL or CDN reference, and implement a graceful fallback (e.g., branded placeholder or cuisine-type illustration) with retry logic for failed image loads.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge, truncating the restaurant name to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no visual ellipsis, which reads as broken text.
issues.suggestion: If this is a horizontal carousel, keep the peek but ensure the title within the card is truncated with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') or adjust card width/padding so the name isn't awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: A sixth category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right screen edge, showing only a thin sliver with no label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or scroll offset so partially visible chips show enough of their label to signal scrollability, or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate more content.
